title: CWP/35982/2019 of HARYANA STATE MINOR IRRIGATION AND TUBEWELL CORPORATION LTD. AND ANR Vs THE PRESIDING OFFICER, INDUSTRIAL TRIBUNAL CUM  LABOUR COURT UT CHD
petitioner: Haryana State Minor Irrigation And Tubewell Corporation Ltd. And Anr

text:
205 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Date of Decision : 11-07-2025 HARYANA STATE MINOR IRRIGATION AND TUBEWELL CORPORATION LTD. AND ANR. ........Petitioner(s) VERSUS THE PRESIDING OFFICER, INDUSTRIAL TRIBUNAL CUM LABOUR COURT UT CHD. ........Respondent(s) CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE HARSIMRAN SINGH SETHI Present: None. HARSIMRAN SINGH SETHI, J. (Oral)

1. The issue raised in the present petition had already been decided by this Court in CWP No.4165 of 2019 titled “HSMITC Ltd and anr. Versus The Presiding Officer , Labour Court and anr.” decided on 11.02.2025 hence, the present petition needs to be disposed of in the same terms.

2. Since nobody had appeared on behalf of the parties hence, the present petition is disposed of in terms of CWP No.4165 of 2019 titled “HSMITC Ltd and anr. Versus The Presiding Officer , Labour Court and anr.” decided on 11.02.2025.

3. Pending application, if any, also stands disposed of. (HARSIMRAN SINGH SETHI) 11-07-2025 JUDGE Sapna Goyal NOTE: Whether speaking: YES
